## 实现总结

### 1. **TechPointListSidebar 组件** (`frontend/src/components/project/TechPointListSidebar.tsx`)
   - 添加了"添加技术点"按钮（标题栏和空状态）
   - 点击后跳转到技术点库页面，传递选择模式参数
   - 添加了 `refreshTrigger` 属性支持外部触发刷新

### 2. **ProjectManagementPage 页面** (`frontend/src/pages/ProjectManagementPage.tsx`)
   - 监听 URL 参数 `selectedTechPointIds`
   - 当从技术点库返回时，批量调用 API 将技术点添加到项目
   - 添加成功后显示提示消息并刷新技术点列表
   - 使用 `refreshTrigger` 状态触发技术点列表刷新

### 功能流程

1. 用户在项目管理页面点击"添加技术点"按钮
2. 跳转到技术点库页面（选择模式）
3. 用户选择技术点并确认
4. 返回项目管理页面，URL 包含 `selectedTechPointIds` 参数
5. 页面自动调用 API 将选中的技术点添加到项目
6. 显示成功/失败消息并刷新技术点列表

所有代码已通过 lint 检查，功能已实现。

```diff
+         setAssociatedCarModels([]);
+       }
+ 
+       if (knowledgePointsResult.status === 'fulfilled' &amp;&amp; knowledgePointsResult.value.success) {
+         const response = knowledgePointsResult.value;
+         let kpData: KnowledgePoint[] = [];
+         if (response.data) {
+           if (Array.isArray(response.data)) {
+             kpData = response.data;
+           } else if (response.data.data &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(response.data.data)) {
+             kpData = response.data.data;
+           }
+         }
+         setKnowledgePoints(kpData);
+       } else {
+         setKnowledgePoints([]);
+       }
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error('获取关联数据失败:', err);
+       setAssociatedContent({
+         packagingMaterials: [],
+         promotionStrategies: [],
+         pressReleases: [],
+         speeches: [],
+         resources: [],
+       });
+       setAssociatedCarModels([]);
+       setAssociatedResources([]);
+       setKnowledgePoints([]);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const formatDate = (dateString: string | undefined | null) =&gt; {
+     if (!dateString) return '未知';
+     try {
+       const date = dayjs(dateString);
+       if (!date.isValid()) return '未知';
+       return date.format('YYYY/MM/DD');
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('日期格式化失败:', error);
+       return '未知';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getStatusColor = (status: string) =&gt; {
+     switch (status) {
+       case 'active':
+         return 'success';
+       case 'inactive':
+         return 'default';
+       case 'draft':
+         return 'warning';
+       case 'archived':
+         return 'error';
+       default:
+         return 'default';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) =&gt; {
+     switch (priority) {
+       case 'high':
+         return 'error';
+       case 'medium':
+         return 'warning';
+       case 'low':
+         return 'success';
+       default:
+         return 'default';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getTypeColor = (type: string) =&gt; {
+     switch (type) {
+       case 'feature':
+         return 'blue';
+       case 'improvement':
+         return 'cyan';
+       case 'innovation':
+         return 'purple';
+       case 'technology':
+         return 'geekblue';
+       default:
+         return 'default';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleSave = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setSaving(true);
+       const response = await techPointService.updateTechPoint(techPoint.id, {
+         name: formData.name,
+         description: formData.description,
+         tech_type: formData.tech_type,
+         priority: formData.priority,
+         status: formData.status
+       } as any);
+ 
+       if (response.success) {
+         setEditing(false);
+         message.success('保存成功');
+         await fetchTechPointData();
+         onSave?.();
+       } else {
+         message.error(response.error || '保存失败');
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('保存失败:', error);
+       message.error('保存失败');
+     } finally {
+       setSaving(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const renderKnowledgePoints = () =&gt; {
+     if (knowledgePoints &amp;&amp; knowledgePoints.length &gt; 0) {
+       const groupedByTitle: Record&lt;string, KnowledgePoint[]&gt; = {};
+       knowledgePoints.forEach(kp =&gt; {
+         let title = kp.title || '未分类';
+         const titleMatch = title.match(/^(.+?)\s+\d+$/);
+         if (titleMatch) {
+           title = titleMatch[1];
+         }
+         
+         if (!groupedByTitle[title]) {
+           groupedByTitle[title] = [];
+         }
+         groupedByTitle[title].push(kp);
+       });
+ 
+       const titleOrder = ['技术原理', '价值', '适用边界', '技术亮点', '实测证据', '认证证据', '对比证据'];
+       const sortedTitles = Object.keys(groupedByTitle).sort((a, b) =&gt; {
+         const indexA = titleOrder.indexOf(a);
+         const indexB = titleOrder.indexOf(b);
+         if (indexA !== -1 &amp;&amp; indexB !== -1) return indexA - indexB;
+         if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
+         if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
+         return a.localeCompare(b);
+       });
+ 
+       return (
+         &lt;div className="space-y-3"&gt;
+           {sortedTitles.map((title) =&gt; {
+             const kps = groupedByTitle[title];
+             return (
+               &lt;div key={title}&gt;
+                 &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- {title}：&lt;/Text&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+                   {kps.length === 1 ? (
+                     &lt;Text className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap"&gt;{kps[0].content}&lt;/Text&gt;
+                   ) : (
+                     kps.map((kp, index) =&gt; (
+                       &lt;div key={kp.id || index} className="mb-1"&gt;
+                         &lt;Text className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap"&gt;{kp.content}&lt;/Text&gt;
+                       &lt;/div&gt;
+                     ))
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             );
+           })}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     const principle = currentTechPoint.technical_details?.tech_principle || 
+                      currentTechPoint.tech_principle || 
+                      parsedDescription.principle || '';
+     const value = currentTechPoint.technical_details?.tech_value || 
+                  currentTechPoint.tech_value || 
+                  parsedDescription.value || '';
+     const boundary = currentTechPoint.technical_details?.tech_boundary || 
+                     currentTechPoint.tech_boundary || 
+                     parsedDescription.boundary || '';
+     const highlights = currentTechPoint.technical_details?.highlights || 
+                       currentTechPoint.highlights || 
+                       parsedDescription.highlights || [];
+     const evidenceMeasured = currentTechPoint.technical_details?.evidence_measured || 
+                             currentTechPoint.evidence_measured || 
+                             parsedDescription.evidenceMeasured || [];
+     const evidenceCertified = currentTechPoint.technical_details?.evidence_certified || 
+                              currentTechPoint.evidence_certified || 
+                              parsedDescription.evidenceCertified || [];
+     const evidenceComparison = currentTechPoint.technical_details?.evidence_comparison || 
+                               currentTechPoint.evidence_comparison || 
+                               parsedDescription.evidenceComparison || [];
+ 
+     const hasAnyData = principle || value || boundary || 
+                       (Array.isArray(highlights) &amp;&amp; highlights.length &gt; 0) || 
+                       (Array.isArray(evidenceMeasured) &amp;&amp; evidenceMeasured.length &gt; 0) || 
+                       (Array.isArray(evidenceCertified) &amp;&amp; evidenceCertified.length &gt; 0) || 
+                       (Array.isArray(evidenceComparison) &amp;&amp; evidenceComparison.length &gt; 0);
+ 
+     if (!hasAnyData) {
+       return &lt;Empty description="暂无知识点" image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} /&gt;;
+     }
+ 
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="space-y-3"&gt;
+         {principle &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- 技术原理：&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+               &lt;Text className="text-sm"&gt;{principle}&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {value &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- 价值：&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+               &lt;Text className="text-sm"&gt;{value}&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {boundary &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- 适用边界：&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+               &lt;Text className="text-sm"&gt;{boundary}&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {Array.isArray(highlights) &amp;&amp; highlights.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- 技术亮点：&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+               {highlights.map((item: string, index: number) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div key={index} className="mb-1"&gt;
+                   &lt;Text className="text-sm"&gt;{item}&lt;/Text&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {Array.isArray(evidenceMeasured) &amp;&amp; evidenceMeasured.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- 实测证据：&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+               {evidenceMeasured.map((item: string, index: number) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div key={index} className="mb-1"&gt;
+                   &lt;Text className="text-sm"&gt;{item}&lt;/Text&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {Array.isArray(evidenceCertified) &amp;&amp; evidenceCertified.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- 认证证据：&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+               {evidenceCertified.map((item: string, index: number) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div key={index} className="mb-1"&gt;
+                   &lt;Text className="text-sm"&gt;{item}&lt;/Text&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {Array.isArray(evidenceComparison) &amp;&amp; evidenceComparison.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;Text strong className="text-sm"&gt;- 对比证据：&lt;/Text&gt;
+             &lt;div className="ml-4 mt-1"&gt;
+               {evidenceComparison.map((item: string, index: number) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div key={index} className="mb-1"&gt;
+                   &lt;Text className="text-sm"&gt;{item}&lt;/Text&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="h-full flex flex-col bg-white"&gt;
+       {/* 头部 */}
+       &lt;div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
+           &lt;Package className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600" /&gt;
+           &lt;h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900"&gt;技术点详情&lt;/h2&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+           {editing ? (
+             &lt;&gt;
+               &lt;button
+                 onClick={() =&gt; {
+                   setFormData(currentTechPoint);
+                   setEditing(false);
+                 }}
+                 className="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
+               &gt;
+                 取消
+               &lt;/button&gt;
+               &lt;button
+                 onClick={handleSave}
+                 disabled={saving}
+                 className="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50"
+               &gt;
+                 &lt;Save className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+                 保存
+               &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;/&gt;
+           ) : (
+             &lt;&gt;
+               &lt;button
+                 onClick={() =&gt; setEditing(true)}
+                 className="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
+               &gt;
+                 &lt;Edit2 className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+                 编辑
+               &lt;/button&gt;
+               {onClose &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;button
+                   onClick={onClose}
+                   className="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
+                 &gt;
+                   &lt;X className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+                 &lt;/button&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 内容区域 */}
+       &lt;div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6"&gt;
+         {loading ? (
+           &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12"&gt;
+             &lt;Spin size="large" /&gt;
+             &lt;span className="ml-3 text-gray-500"&gt;加载中...&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         ) : (
+           &lt;div className="max-w-4xl space-y-6"&gt;
+             {/* 基本信息卡片 */}
+             &lt;Card title="基本信息" size="small" className="shadow-sm"&gt;
+               &lt;Descriptions column={2} size="small"&gt;
+                 &lt;Descriptions.Item label="技术领域"&gt;
+                   {categoryName || currentTechPoint.category?.name || '未关联技术领域'}
+                 &lt;/Descriptions.Item&gt;
+                 &lt;Descriptions.Item label="技术IP"&gt;
+                   {technologyName || '未关联技术IP'}
+                 &lt;/Descriptions.Item&gt;
+                 &lt;Descriptions.Item label="创建时间"&gt;
+                   &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                     &lt;CalendarOutlined className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" /&gt;
+                     {formatDate(currentTechPoint.created_at)}
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/Descriptions.Item&gt;
+                 &lt;Descriptions.Item label="更新时间"&gt;
+                   &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                     &lt;CalendarOutlined className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" /&gt;
+                     {formatDate(currentTechPoint.updated_at)}
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/Descriptions.Item&gt;
+               &lt;/Descriptions&gt;
+ 
+               &lt;Divider className="my-4" /&gt;
+ 
+               {/* 可编辑字段 */}
+               &lt;div className="space-y-4"&gt;
+                 &lt;div&gt;
+                   &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;名称&lt;/label&gt;
+                   {editing ? (
+                     &lt;input
+                       type="text"
+                       value={formData.name}
+                       onChange={(e) =&gt; setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
+                       className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500"
+                     /&gt;
+                   ) : (
+                     &lt;div className="text-base text-gray-900"&gt;{currentTechPoint.name}&lt;/div&gt;
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div&gt;
+                   &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;技术类型&lt;/label&gt;
+                   {editing ? (
+                     &lt;select
+                       value={formData.tech_type}
+                       onChange={(e) =&gt; setFormData({ ...formData, tech_type: e.target.value as any })}
+                       className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500"
+                     &gt;
+                       &lt;option value="feature"&gt;功能特性&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="improvement"&gt;改进优化&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="innovation"&gt;创新技术&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="technology"&gt;核心技术&lt;/option&gt;
+                     &lt;/select&gt;
+                   ) : (
+                     &lt;Tag color={getTypeColor(currentTechPoint.tech_type)}&gt;{currentTechPoint.tech_type}&lt;/Tag&gt;
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div&gt;
+                   &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;优先级&lt;/label&gt;
+                   {editing ? (
+                     &lt;select
+                       value={formData.priority}
+                       onChange={(e) =&gt; setFormData({ ...formData, priority: e.target.value as any })}
+                       className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500"
+                     &gt;
+                       &lt;option value="high"&gt;高&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="medium"&gt;中&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="low"&gt;低&lt;/option&gt;
+                     &lt;/select&gt;
+                   ) : (
+                     &lt;Tag color={getPriorityColor(currentTechPoint.priority)}&gt;{currentTechPoint.priority}&lt;/Tag&gt;
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div&gt;
+                   &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;状态&lt;/label&gt;
+                   {editing ? (
+                     &lt;select
+                       value={formData.status}
+                       onChange={(e) =&gt; setFormData({ ...formData, status: e.target.value as any })}
+                       className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500"
+                     &gt;
+                       &lt;option value="draft"&gt;草稿&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="active"&gt;启用&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="inactive"&gt;禁用&lt;/option&gt;
+                       &lt;option value="archived"&gt;归档&lt;/option&gt;
+                     &lt;/select&gt;
+                   ) : (
+                     &lt;Tag color={getStatusColor(currentTechPoint.status)}&gt;{currentTechPoint.status}&lt;/Tag&gt;
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div&gt;
+                   &lt;label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"&gt;描述&lt;/label&gt;
+                   {editing ? (
+                     &lt;textarea
+                       value={formData.description || ''}
+                       onChange={(e) =&gt; setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
+                       rows={6}
+                       className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500"
+                     /&gt;
+                   ) : (
+                     &lt;div className="text-sm text-gray-700 whitespace-pre-wrap"&gt;
+                       {currentTechPoint.description || '暂无描述'}
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 {currentTechPoint.description &amp;&amp; !editing &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;&gt;
+                     &lt;Divider className="my-4" /&gt;
+                     &lt;div&gt;
+                       &lt;Text strong className="block mb-2"&gt;完整描述&lt;/Text&gt;
+                       &lt;div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm text-gray-700 leading-relaxed"&gt;
+                         {currentTechPoint.description}
+                       &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                   &lt;/&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/Card&gt;
+ 
+             {/* 知识点记录卡片 */}
+             &lt;Card 
+               title={
+                 &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                   &lt;BookOutlined className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+                   &lt;span&gt;知识点记录&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               }
+               size="small"
+               className="shadow-sm"
+             &gt;
+               {renderKnowledgePoints()}
+             &lt;/Card&gt;
+ 
+             {/* 关联车型卡片 */}
+             &lt;Card
+               title={
+                 &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                   &lt;CarOutlined className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+                   &lt;span&gt;关联车型&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               }
+               size="small"
+               className="shadow-sm"
+             &gt;
+               {associatedCarModels.length &gt; 0 ? (
+                 &lt;div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"&gt;
+                   {associatedCarModels.map((carModel: any) =&gt; {
+                     const brandName = carModel.brand_name?.trim();
+                     const modelName = carModel.name?.trim() || '未知车型';
+                     const displayName = brandName &amp;&amp; brandName !== '' 
+                       ? &#96;${brandName} ${modelName}&#96; 
+                       : modelName;
+                     
+                     return (
+                       &lt;Tag key={carModel.id} color="blue"&gt;
+                         {displayName}
+                       &lt;/Tag&gt;
+                     );
+                   })}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ) : (
+                 &lt;Empty description="暂无关联车型" image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} /&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/Card&gt;
+ 
+             {/* 关联资源卡片 */}
+             &lt;Card
+               title={
+                 &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                   &lt;FileImageOutlined className="w-4 h-4" /&gt;
+                   &lt;span&gt;关联资源&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               }
+               size="small"
+               className="shadow-sm"
+             &gt;
+               {associatedResources.length &gt; 0 ? (
+                 &lt;Row gutter={[16, 16]}&gt;
+                   {associatedResources.map((resource: any) =&gt; {
+                     let attachments: any[] = [];
+                     if (resource.attachments) {
+                       if (typeof resource.attachments === 'string') {
+                         try {
+                           attachments = JSON.parse(resource.attachments);
+                         } catch (e) {
+                           console.error('解析附件失败:', e);
+                         }
+                       } else if (Array.isArray(resource.attachments)) {
+                         attachments = resource.attachments;
+                       }
+                     }
+ 
+                     if (attachments.length === 0) {
+                       return (
+                         &lt;Col key={resource.id} xs={12} sm={8} md={6} lg={4}&gt;
+                           &lt;Card
+                             hoverable
+                             size="small"
+                             bodyStyle={{ padding: '8px', textAlign: 'center' }}
+                           &gt;
+                             &lt;FileOutlined style={{ fontSize: '32px', color: '#1890ff', marginBottom: '8px' }} /&gt;
+                             &lt;div style={{ fontSize: '12px', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}&gt;
+                               {resource.name || '未命名资源'}
+                             &lt;/div&gt;
+                           &lt;/Card&gt;
+                         &lt;/Col&gt;
+                       );
+                     }
+ 
+                     return attachments.map((attachment: any, index: number) =&gt; {
+                       const getFileUrl = (url: string) =&gt; {
+                         if (url.startsWith('http')) return url;
+                         if (url.startsWith('/')) return url;
+                         return &#96;/${url}&#96;;
+                       };
+ 
+                       const isImage = attachment.mimeType?.startsWith('image/') || 
+                                      attachment.type?.startsWith('image/') ||
+                                      resource.type === '产品素材';
+                       const isVideo = attachment.mimeType?.startsWith('video/') || 
+                                      attachment.type?.startsWith('video/') ||
+                                      resource.type === '实拍视频';
+                       const fileUrl = getFileUrl(attachment.url || attachment.file_url || '');
+ 
+                       return (
+                         &lt;Col key={&#96;${resource.id}-${index}&#96;} xs={12} sm={8} md={6} lg={4}&gt;
+                           &lt;Card
+                             hoverable
+                             size="small"
+                             bodyStyle={{ padding: '8px' }}
+                             onClick={() =&gt; {
+                               if (isImage) {
+                                 Modal.info({
+                                   title: attachment.name || resource.name,
+                                   width: 800,
+                                   content: (
+                                     &lt;Image
+                                       src={fileUrl}
+                                       alt={attachment.name || resource.name}
+                                       style={{ width: '100%' }}
+                                       preview={{
+                                         mask: '查看大图'
+                                       }}
+                                     /&gt;
+                                   ),
+                                   okText: '关闭',
+                                 });
+                               } else if (isVideo) {
+                                 Modal.info({
+                                   title: attachment.name || resource.name,
+                                   width: 800,
+                                   content: (
+                                     &lt;video
+                                       src={fileUrl}
+                                       style={{ width: '100%' }}
+                                       controls
+                                     /&gt;
+                                   ),
+                                   okText: '关闭',
+                                 });
+                               } else {
+                                 window.open(fileUrl, '_blank');
+                               }
+                             }}
+                           &gt;
+                             &lt;div style={{ 
+                               aspectRatio: '16/9', 
+                               backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5', 
+                               marginBottom: '8px', 
+                               display: 'flex', 
+                               alignItems: 'center', 
+                               justifyContent: 'center',
+                               borderRadius: '4px',
+                               overflow: 'hidden'
+                             }}&gt;
+                               {isImage ? (
+                                 &lt;Image
+                                   src={fileUrl}
+                                   alt={attachment.name || resource.name}
+                                   preview={false}
+                                   style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
+                                 /&gt;
+                               ) : isVideo ? (
+                                 &lt;div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}&gt;
+                                   &lt;video
+                                     src={fileUrl}
+                                     style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
+                                     preload="metadata"
+                                   /&gt;
+                                   &lt;div style={{
+                                     position: 'absolute',
+                                     top: '50%',
+                                     left: '50%',
+                                     transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
+                                     background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
+                                     borderRadius: '50%',
+                                     width: '40px',
+                                     height: '40px',
+                                     display: 'flex',
+                                     alignItems: 'center',
+                                     justifyContent: 'center'
+                                   }}&gt;
+                                     &lt;VideoCameraOutlined style={{ fontSize: '20px', color: '#fff' }} /&gt;
+                                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                               ) : (
+                                 &lt;div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', height: '100%' }}&gt;
+                                   &lt;FileOutlined style={{ fontSize: '32px', color: '#1890ff' }} /&gt;
+                                   &lt;div style={{ marginTop: '8px', fontSize: '12px', color: '#666' }}&gt;
+                                     {attachment.mimeType?.includes('pdf') ? 'PDF' :
+                                      attachment.mimeType?.includes('word') || attachment.mimeType?.includes('document') ? 'Word' :
+                                      attachment.mimeType?.includes('excel') || attachment.mimeType?.includes('spreadsheet') ? 'Excel' :
+                                      attachment.mimeType?.includes('powerpoint') || attachment.mimeType?.includes('presentation') ? 'PowerPoint' :
+                                      '文档'}
+                                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                               )}
+                             &lt;/div&gt;
+                             &lt;div style={{ 
+                               fontSize: '12px', 
+                               overflow: 'hidden', 
+                               textOverflow: 'ellipsis', 
+                               whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
+                               textAlign: 'center'
+                             }}&gt;
+                               {attachment.name || resource.name || '未命名'}
+                             &lt;/div&gt;
+                           &lt;/Card&gt;
+                         &lt;/Col&gt;
+                       );
+                     });
+                   })}
+                 &lt;/Row&gt;
+               ) : (
+                 &lt;Empty description="暂无关联资源" image={Empty.PRESENTED_IMAGE_SIMPLE} /&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/Card&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default TechPointDetailPanel;
+ 
```

</details>

## 实现总结

已重写 `TechPointDetailPanel` 组件，整合完整显示和编辑功能：

### 主要功能

1. **完整信息显示**
   - 基本信息：技术领域、技术IP、创建时间、更新时间
   - 可编辑字段：名称、技术类型、优先级、状态、描述
   - 完整描述：显示技术点的完整描述内容
   - 知识点记录：从知识点API或技术点字段中解析显示
   - 关联车型：显示关联的车型列表
   - 关联资源：显示关联的资源（图片、视频、文档等）

2. **编辑功能**
   - 点击"编辑"按钮进入编辑模式
   - 可编辑：名称、描述、技术类型、优先级、状态
   - 保存后自动刷新数据并显示成功提示

3. **数据加载**
   - 自动加载技术点的完整信息
   - 加载关联数据（知识点、车型、资源）
   - 显示加载状态

4. **UI优化**
   - 使用 Ant Design 组件保持一致的UI风格
   - 卡片式布局，信息分组清晰
   - 响应式设计，适配不同屏幕尺寸

技术点详情面板现在可显示完整信息，并支持编辑。

## 实现总结

已集成编辑模态框功能到 `TechPointDetailPanel` 组件：

### 主要改动

1. **移除内联编辑**
   - 移除了 `editing`、`formData`、`saving` 等内联编辑相关状态
   - 移除了 `handleSave` 函数
   - 移除了所有可编辑字段的条件渲染代码

2. **集成编辑模态框**
   - 导入 `TechPointEditModal` 组件
   - 添加 `editModalVisible` 状态控制模态框显示
   - 点击"编辑"按钮时打开模态框

3. **编辑功能**
   - 编辑成功后自动刷新技术点数据
   - 显示成功提示消息
   - 触发 `onSave` 回调通知父组件

4. **UI 优化**
   - 简化头部按钮，只保留"编辑"和"关闭"按钮
   - 所有字段改为只读显示
   - 编辑功能通过模态框实现，与技术点库页面保持一致

现在点击"编辑"按钮会弹出与技术点库页面相同的编辑模态框，可编辑技术点的完整内容，包括基本信息、技术详情、技术亮点与证据等。

## 实现总结

已在 `TechPointDetailPanel` 组件中添加“AI挖掘”功能：

### 主要功能

1. **AI挖掘按钮**
   - 在“编辑”按钮左侧添加“AI挖掘”按钮
   - 使用紫色主题区分
   - 挖掘时显示加载状态和动画

2. **AI挖掘流程**
   - 获取项目的AI共创信息：通过 `sourceService.loadSourceInformationByProjectId()` 获取
   - 调用Agent挖掘：使用 `workflowAPI.aiSearch()` 调用AI Agent
   - 解析挖掘结果：解析AI返回的JSON数据
   - 更新技术点：将挖掘的信息更新到技术点

3. **挖掘内容**
   - 技术描述（description）
   - 技术细节（technical_details）：
     - 技术原理（tech_principle）
     - 技术价值（tech_value）
     - 技术边界（tech_boundary）
     - 技术亮点（highlights）
     - 实测证据（evidence_measured）
     - 认证证据（evidence_certified）
     - 对比证据（evidence_comparison）
   - 技术优势（benefits）
   - 应用场景（applications）
   - 关键词（keywords）

4. **用户体验**
   - 挖掘过程中显示“挖掘中...”状态
   - 成功/失败提示消息
   - 自动刷新技术点数据
   - 触发 `onSave` 回调通知父组件

### 技术实现

- 复用项目已有的AI挖掘逻辑（参考 `ProjectResourcesPage.tsx` 中的 `handleExtractTechPoint`）
- 使用相同的AI配置（`smart-workflow-ai-qa`）
- 智能合并挖掘结果与现有数据，避免覆盖已有信息

功能已实现，可在技术点详情面板中使用“AI挖掘”功能，自动从项目的AI共创信息中挖掘并更新技术点信息。
